title: PipelineAnalyzeProposalResponse
description: Dry analyze over a not-yet-created PipelineProposal (HEL-381): the projected source schema per root, per-step input/output schema, any per-step validation errors, and (HEL-914 task 6b.4a) every proposed Output's fieldMapping validity grounded at that Output's own target node (or root schema, for a root-bound Output) -- never the pipeline trunk. Nothing is persisted. Additive sibling of GET /api/pipelines/:id/analyze's PipelineAnalyzeResponse -- carries no id/outputDataTypeId, since nothing has been created yet (design.md D4). HEL-914: `sourceName`/`sourceSchema` (singular) REPLACED outright by `sourceSchemas`, one entry per proposed root, matching the persisted-pipeline twin's `RootSourceSchema` $def exactly so the two shapes cannot drift. The steps[] shape mirrors the discriminated-union wire format analyzeStepResponseFormat emits (a `type` discriminator plus an object `config`) -- the same fields as pipeline-analyze-response.schema.json's $defs.AnalyzeStep, which HEL-1266 corrected to that shape (design.md D6). It is kept as a local copy, $defs.AnalyzeProposalStep, rather than a cross-file $ref: the backend schema test harness compiles this file standalone and cannot resolve a cross-file $ref by $id offline (HEL-1281).

warnings.description: HEL-1235: schema-only, NON-BLOCKING pre-run findings, computed from the inferred schemas with no row reads. Always present (empty when none). Never sets a step's validationError, never affects costVerdict (canRun/autoRunnable/reasons), never blocks a write or an auto-run. Wording states the evidence base (the stored inferred schema can be stale). Distinct from propose_pipeline's `warnings: string[]` (which drives applyReady) and from run warnings.

stepId.description: The step the warning is about (the proposal's client step id for a proposal analyze).

AnalyzeProposalStep.description: Matches the analyzeStepResponseFormat wire shape (type discriminator + object config) -- the same fields as pipeline-analyze-response.schema.json's $defs.AnalyzeStep (corrected by HEL-1266). A local copy rather than a cross-file $ref, which the backend schema test harness cannot resolve offline (HEL-1281); keep the two in step. `config` is a permissive object (additionalProperties: true) rather than a full per-kind oneOf union across all step kinds -- more precision than this ticket's scope needs (design.md D6).

OutputAnalyze.description: HEL-914 task 6b.4a: one entry per proposed Output, in request order. `validationError` is present only when that Output's fieldMapping is invalid at its own grounded node -- absent when valid or when the Output has no fieldMapping.
